script_text: Stop! Gemini, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury is retrograde in your 3rd House of Communication, squaring your ruling planet and opposing your 10th House of Career with tense friction. This air-born mind is racing, but old thoughts are circling back. Your ruling planet demands honesty before you speak. Love now means an old message resurfaces; if partnered, watch for defensive silence instead of honest words. If single, attraction comes through restless curiosity, so keep your options open but your intentions clear. Career or money needs patience: review contracts and emails before sending, especially with this square heating your 10th House. Avoid signing anything before noon, and don't force a friendship-ending talk after lunch. Instead, let unexpected clarity gift you a fresh perspective tonight. The cosmic noise will settle by midnight. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
